Title: Delivered pages emit relative canonical/og:url tags and sign-in/account pages are indexable
Description: Found during MVP-021 pre-work. A production-build probe with the same metadata shape as the product/category pages emitted relative canonical and og:url values and a localhost-based og:image (no metadataBase is set); sign-in and account pages carry no robots directive. No production deployment exists so nothing was exposed. Fixed by MVP-021 (FR-017). See planning/bugs/BUG-001.md.

Title: A repeated query parameter (?q=a&q=b) makes /search and category pages return HTTP 500
Description: normalizeQuery calls .trim() on a value Next.js passes as an array for a repeated parameter, so /search and category pages throw TypeError and return 500. Found while verifying MVP-021 against real pages; the code is unchanged by MVP-021 and out of its scope (MVP-004 search behavior may not be modified). See planning/bugs/BUG-002.md.
